title: Condor 1-Drum Modular Polyethylene Spill Containment Deck (15-Gallon Sump, 2,000 lb Capacity)
description: CONDOR 1633BC is an uncovered, low-profile spill deck for secondary spill containment under one 55-gallon drum or compatible container within the productâs load and spill capacity ratings. Made of black polyethylene, it has a 15 gal spill capacity for secondary spill containment in indoor storage and handling areas and a rated load capacity of 2,000 lb. Its modular design allows use with ramp connection model 1689BC. Key Features: 15 gal spill capacity for liquid beneath stored containers. Holds 1 drum; not designed for IBC use. Rated load capacity: 2,000 lb. Low-profile deck measures 26 1/4 in L x 26 1/4 in W x 6 1/2 in H. Polyethylene construction with black pallet and grate. Uncovered design with no doors and no drain. Modular unit; compatible with ramp connection model 1689BC. For indoor use. No forklift pockets. References EPA 40 CFR 264.175.
